channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran warns Israeli attacks in Lebanon and Gaza threaten US ceasefire talks
item.description: Iranian officials demand 'ceasefire on all fronts' as Israel deepens Lebanon invasion and threatens to bomb Beirut.

item.title: How the world failed Ryan and Yaman
item.description: An Israeli strike killed my children. What pains me is not just their loss but also the normalisation of their murder.

item.title: Residents flee Beirut’s southern suburbs as Israel orders strikes
item.description: Videos show gridlocked traffic in the southern suburbs of Beirut as residents rushed to evacuate the Dahiyeh area.

item.title: What is Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle, and why has Israel captured it?
item.description: The fortress, a historical battleground, is playing a central role in Israel’s military campaign against Hezbollah.

item.title: Iran warns Israeli attacks in Lebanon threaten ceasefire with US
item.description: Earlier Israel's PM ordered strikes on Beirut's southern suburbs in response to Hezbollah rocket and drone attacks on northern Israel.

item.title: Iran attacks damage 20 US military sites since start of war, satellite images show
item.description: Analysts told BBC Verify that Tehran's strikes were more extensive than publicly acknowledged.

item.title: Israel PM orders strikes on Beirut suburbs as Hezbollah conflict escalates
item.description: Thousands flee the Hezbollah stronghold of Dahieh after Benjamin Netanyahu says it will be targeted in response to attacks on Israeli civilians.

item.title: Trump seeking edits to US-Iran deal, US media report
item.description: The requested changes are related to the Strait of Hormuz and the removal of highly enriched uranium, according to US media.
